definitions.explanation: The punctuation mark (.) used at the end of a sentence in Western writing. In Japanese, the equivalent is the {句点|くてん} (。).
The end or conclusion of something. Used figuratively to mean putting a definitive end to a matter or chapter in one's life.

examples.english: Put a period at the end of a sentence.
In English, sentences end with a period.

examples.japanese: ピリオド⟦と→と：00512_to⟧コンマ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{分|わ}け→使い分け：11559_tsukaiwake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pay attention to the distinction between periods and commas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ピリオド⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: They put a period on the long struggle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ピリオド⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: To bring one's athletic career to an end.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ピリオド⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{打|う}たれた→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: This victory put a definitive end to the long-standing rivalry.

notes:
USAGE:
The key expression is ピリオド⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧, which literally means "to strike a period" and is used both literally (punctuation) and figuratively (to end something decisively). The figurative use (sense 2) is very common in news and sports reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ピリオド⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to put a period on; to bring to an end
- ピリオド⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{打|う}たれる→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: for something to come to an end (passive)
